messages:
Vik: follow-up from the postmortem — recurring OOMs on inference shards after ~2-3 days. summary: slow per-shard resident growth + allocation fragmentation. need clear owners, short mitigations, and a verification plan.

Vik: proposed short list (claim or react):
  - P1: automated heap+jemalloc sampling across canaries (owner?) ETA 72h
  - P2: per-shard soft cap + LRU eviction as a short-term guard (owner?) ETA 5d
  - P3: validate TTL/expiry behavior for shard metadata (owner?) ETA 48h
  - P4: fragmentation analysis + malloc_conf recommendations + microbench (owner?) ETA 10d
  - P5: memory-drift dashboard + alerting + runbook updates (owner?) ETA 4d

Asha: I'll take P1 and P3. will spin a scheduled sampler and validate TTLs. plan to collect pprof + jemalloc stats for 72h and upload artifacts.

Carlos: I'll own P2 and P4. will prototype a background non-blocking eviction and a malloc_conf pilot behind a feature flag. will also add a microbenchmark that simulates long-lived session churn.

Megan: I'll do P5 1; add drift graph (median + p90 resident per-shard) and a sustained-growth alert that pages at severity=P1 if >120MB over 6h. will update runbook with hotfix + rollback thresholds.

Vik: thanks. Asha, paste the minimal sampling commands so infra can create a cronjob. include how you collect jemalloc stats.

Asha: gist (full script in INF-2000):
```
PODS=$(kubectl get pods -l app=infer -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}')
for p in $PODS; do
  kubectl exec $p -- sh -c "pprof -raw /proc/self/exe /tmp/heap.$(date +%s).pprof" || true
  kubectl exec $p -- sh -c "cat /proc/$$/status" > /tmp/meminfo.$p.$(date +%s).txt || true
  kubectl exec $p -- sh -c "curl -s localhost:9191/metrics | grep jemalloc" > /tmp/jemalloc.$p.$(date +%s).txt || true
done
```
I'll attach the scheduled job once infra-bot creates it.

oncall-bot: created scheduled job JOB-2000 to collect heap samples across selected canaries. next run in 2m.

Carlos: eviction design note: eviction will be background-only, triggered when shard resident > working_set * 1.25 for >15m. evictions increment a metric evictions_per_shard and emit eviction_latency_histogram. will ensure requests never block on eviction.

Carlos: malloc_conf pilot will change per-process arena settings on a small canary pool behind a toggle; will monitor arena fragmentation ratio and RSS delta.

Vik: good. Asha, when you validate TTLs, if you confirm metadata not expiring, please prepare a one-line hotfix we can push to canary quickly. set automatic rollback if canary RSS > 2x baseline in 30m.

Asha: will do. early sampling shows a subset of shards with LRU entries not decaying as expected after warmup. could be a race in the warmup path.

Megan: for alerts, I'll create two severities: warning at 50MB drift over 6h, pager at 120MB. also add a dashboard panel for "evictions vs drift" to see correlation.

infra-bot: created ticket INF-2000 "kv-cache shard memory follow-up" and linked incident. assignees: Asha, Carlos, Megan.

Vik: checkpoint plan: Asha (sampling + TTL validation) ETA 48-72h; Carlos (eviction + malloc_conf pilot + microbench) ETA 5-10d; Megan (dashboard + runbook) ETA 4d. schedule a 30m sync in 4 days to review initial deltas and canary plan.

Carlos: I'll add the microbench to the perf repo and link a PR. plan to run it nightly against a canary pool for 2 weeks post-rollout.

Asha: uploading initial pprof snapshots to INF-2000 now, will add a summary after first pass.

Vik: thanks everyone 1. please update INF-2000 with PR links and mark subtasks done as you complete them so we can close the postmortem loop. :white_check_mark:
